Overview.Name: R Venkateshwar Reddy
Overview.Goal: Improve energy levels, support overall health, and maintain a fit and balanced body through simple, consistent meals.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2–3 whole eggs pan fried + cooked vegetables
OR Omelette with onions and greens
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + 1 cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish pan fried + rice + vegetable curry
Meal_3_Dinner: OR Chicken curry + small rice portion + vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals simple and home-style to make it easy to stay consistent.
Prioritise eggs, chicken, or fish in every main meal for better energy and muscle support.
Since social gatherings trigger overeating, eat a protein-rich meal before attending events.
Choose grilled or pan fried options when eating outside and avoid fried starters.
Try to track steps loosely and aim to move more during the day, especially after meals.
Finish dinner at least 2–3 hours before sleep for better digestion.
Drink enough water through the day to support digestion and overall health.
